group_assessment.weighting: A liver-surgery group (Zhongshan Hospital, Fudan University, from the affiliations) that also authored the later WWOX/NME2/oleate paper. Primary for HCC prognosis cohorts; not a WWOX loss-of-function or neurological group. Observation (genotype counts, survival curves, immunostaining) is weighed above the interpretive sentence that the A allele has 'poor prognostic value'.
